scan_limits: Whitelisted source/aggregate files, field/header inspection and known-pattern text scan. Not a comprehensive rights audit or a proof of absence of every possible identifying string. Aggregate figures are unchanged previously inspected artifacts.
excluded: Human records and provisional human tables, raw rows, weights, identities/contact details, author confirmations and workspace audit files.
remaining_release_gates: Specific destination account/record and separate public-release instruction; ownership and license selection confirmed by user.
scope_note: Inherited v1 screening; applies to original candidate content. V2 adds intentional author attribution/citation names and license legal text; see v2 checks.
